ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark pigment) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 8-12% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigment across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters localized at the distal tips. Prominent white linear pixel disruptions concentrated in the lower-left quadrant and upper-right quadrant of the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 62 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 140 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate frequency of irregular peaks and valleys along the trailing edge; left lobe displays a significant indentation approximately midway between the notch and the tip; right lobe edge appears more continuous with micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smooth concave curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, resulting in an upward-swept fluke orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groupings (rosettes) located exclusively on the distal-lateral margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, near-parallel high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) visible on the left lobe; additional scattered, fine-line white disruptions visible on the right lobe central surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the left lobe and extensive barnacle colonization on the posterior fluke tips.
